sloka: न कुम्भकर्णः काकुत्स्थं दृष्ट्वा जीवन् गमिष्यति।दीप्यमानमिवासाद्य पतङ्गो ज्वलनं यथा ।। ६.६६.२७ ।।
transliteration: na kumbhakarṇaḥ kākutsthaṁ dṛṣṭvā jīvan gamiṣyati।dīpyamānamivāsādya pataṅgo jvalanaṁ yathā ।। 6.66.27 ।।

translations.english: "Just as flies reaching the blazing fire can't escape, so also Kumbhakarna can't escape with life after facing Kakuthsa."
